stories.headline: Kast prepares first State of the Nation address amid low approval, cabinet change fallout, and mobilizations
stories.summary: President José Antonio Kast delivered his first Cuenta Pública before Congress on June 1, 2026, after roughly 90 days in office. The run-up was dominated by falling approval ratings (31–36% depending on pollster), criticism from the opposition and allied sectors over a lack of a concrete security plan, the 'megarreforma' fiscal package, budget cuts, and a pre-speech controversy over Kast ordering the transfer of common inmates from the Punta Peuco prison. Kast previewed the speech at a 'Presidente Presente' town hall in Villa Alemana, announcing the 'Rol Único de Vándalos' bill; social organizations called for street protests timed to the address.

stories.headline: Codelco leadership overhaul: new chair Fontaine orders forensic audit of inflated production figures, Q1 profits surge
stories.summary: President Kast appointed economist Bernardo Fontaine to replace Máximo Pacheco as Codelco board chair; Fontaine held his first board session on May 29 and immediately ordered an external forensic audit of 2024–2025 production figures after an internal audit found roughly 27,000 metric tons of copper had been overestimated. Simultaneously, Codelco reported Q1 2026 pre-tax profit nearly quadrupled to US$825 million on strong copper prices, even as own copper production fell 8.1%. Privatization was officially ruled out by the government; the new board set profitability over production volume as the strategic priority.

stories.headline: Constitutional accusation against former Finance Minister Grau fractures Partido Republicano–Chile Vamos coalition
stories.summary: Partido Republicano and the Partido Nacional Libertario announced plans to file a constitutional accusation (acusación constitucional) against former Finance Minister Nicolás Grau over reported US$10.5 billion in fiscal inconsistencies inherited from the Boric administration. Chile Vamos (UDI, RN) initially resisted, calling the move 'inopportune' given ongoing Megarreforma negotiations; Republican senator Arturo Squella and deputy Agustín Romero publicly pressed their coalition partners, triggering a sharp public row before Squella ultimately de-escalated. By week's end, some Chile Vamos members indicated private support for the accusation.

stories.headline: Kast government audit of Boric fiscal legacy triggers political counterattack from former ministers
stories.summary: The Kast administration published findings from a 'total audit' of the outgoing Boric government, citing an unacknowledged US$10.6 billion deterioration in the fiscal balance and broader irregularities across hundreds of state agencies. Former Boric cabinet ministers, led by ex-spokesperson Camila Vallejo, mounted a coordinated public defense, accusing the current government of political manipulation. Separate flashpoints included a Junaeb fraud allegation pointing to Boric-era decisions and the Ministry of Security adopting Boric's own national security policy as its own.

stories.headline: Chile hosts South American summit, 'Compromiso de Santiago' signed to coordinate fight against Tren de Aragua and organized crime
stories.summary: Chile hosted a regional security summit on May 28–29 attended by five South American countries (Chile, Argentina, Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador), resulting in the 'Compromiso de Santiago'—a joint commitment to coordinate technical, operational, and financial intelligence efforts against transnational organized crime including the Tren de Aragua network. President Kast and Chile's national prosecutor participated; the foreign minister announced shared information would begin within 90 days.

stories.headline: Partido Republicano deputy harassed and spat on at Universidad de Chile; Kast condemns attack
stories.summary: Deputy Javiera Rodríguez of the Partido Republicano was subjected to a 'funa' (public shaming) by students at the Law Faculty of the Universidad de Chile, including spitting and shoving. Rodríguez had previously filed a complaint with the PDI over death threats referencing Charlie Kirk. President Kast condemned the incident on social media, calling universities 'a space for debate, not hatred.'

stories.headline: Ministry of Women in crisis: alleged misconduct, irregular contracts, and internal tensions involving Chile Vamos
stories.summary: Investigative reporting (The Clinic) and follow-on coverage alleged that Minister of Women Judith Marín made threats of dismissal to subordinates, had staffers hired without required qualifications, and made disparaging remarks about Chile Vamos coalition partners. The scandal also intersected with a break-in at the ministry involving stolen laptops, Prada glasses, and coins—an incident the opposition used to highlight hypocrisy, citing Kast's past criticism of a similar event under Boric.

stories.headline: Chilean Armed Forces: F-35 evaluation, first female F-16 pilot, NATO cataloguing upgrade, and security operations in Arauco
stories.summary: Several distinct but related military developments emerged this week: the Defense Minister acknowledged Chile is formally evaluating the F-35 to replace aging F-5 Tiger III fighters; the Air Force graduated its first female F-16 pilot; Chile is working toward NATO Level 2 cataloguing certification to enable defense exports; and Air Force and Navy helicopters continued security operations in the Arauco zone. The Defense Minister also conducted an inspection tour of forces in Magallanes and Punta Arenas.

stories.headline: Kast appoints former President Eduardo Frei as Special Mission Ambassador
stories.summary: President Kast appointed former Christian Democrat president Eduardo Frei Ruiz-Tagle as Chile's Ambassador on Special Mission, confirmed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The role is ad honorem and leverages Frei's international experience; the appointment was seen as a diplomatic outreach across political lines ahead of the Cuenta Pública. Frei had previously served as Asia-Pacific special envoy, a role ended by the Boric administration.
